concepts.label: Couchbase Server 7.6.3
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the stated minimum Server version for Sync Gateway/Eventing interoperability, not yet in the registry

concepts.label: Sync Gateway 3.2.0
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - the Eventing-interoperability threshold on this page; also independently attested by compatibility.json's unsupported-CBL-4.0-combination warning and release-notes.json's CBG-4939 fixed issue in this same batch (recurrence 3 across the batch)

concepts.label: import_mutation_aware flag (Eventing, Sync Gateway interop)
concepts.reused_or_minted: minted - a specific opt-in boolean flag preventing duplicate mutations when Eventing and Sync Gateway share a bucket, with a stated performance tradeoff; not previously in the registry

relations.subject: eventing:function
relations.evidence: Sync Gateway 3.2.0 and later supports interoperability with Eventing from Couchbase Server version 7.6.3+.

relations.subject: eventing:function
relations.evidence: Sync Gateway must be running with [Configuration Overview](../configuration/configuration-overview.md) enabled to support compatibility with Eventing.

relations.subject: sgw:legacy-pre-3-config
relations.evidence: Databases created via file-based configuration (when running with `-disable_persistent_config`) are not recorded in the Couchbase Server registry.

relations.subject: eventing:function
relations.evidence: You can now create Eventing functions with read-write bindings with the source bucket associated with a Sync Gateway database.

relations.subject: eventing:import-mutation-aware-flag
relations.evidence: If the `import_mutation_aware` flag is set to `true`, the performance of the Eventing function drops.

notable_absence.finding: The pre-7.6.3 procedure describes Eventing functions needing to be hand-written idempotent, using a crc64() call to distinguish Sync-Gateway-metadata-only mutations from body mutations - a workaround pattern with no first-class name on the page (just described in prose). No concept was minted for this pattern since the page itself never names it, unlike import_mutation_aware which IS a named, documented flag.

cross_component_finding: This page's warning that mixed-version Sync Gateway clusters (some nodes pre-3.2, some 3.2+) deployed with Eventing can cause 'infinite recursions and duplicate mutations' during upgrade is the exact failure mode that release-notes.json's new sgw:cluster-compatibility-version / sgw:non-disruptive-rolling-upgrade feature (4.1) appears designed to make safer to reason about - though this eventing-compatibility page does not itself reference cluster compatibility version, since it predates 4.1's rolling-upgrade feature in its own framing.
